title: zazz-sdk component diagram
description: The zazz-sdk crate (lib zazz), the std-only SDK every zazz script is written against, and what crosses its boundary. It is used three ways: zazzled embeds its source files with include_str! and compiles them into an rlib for each script build; zazzled and zazz-worker also link it as an ordinary path dependency for the frame protocol, descriptor passing, JSON and the human command line; and scripts call zazz::serve and test with zazz::test. Not deployed on its own. Its modules are drawn in the source folder's diagram.

components.name: zazz-sdk crate
components.responsibility: Builds the zazz library with no dependencies, on purpose, so zazzled can compile it with plain rustc for every script.

components.name: zazz SDK source
components.responsibility: Handlers and serve, the per-call context, the launcher protocol and its native and WASM backends, HTTP, JSON, errors, the human command line, output rendering and the zazz::test library.

components.name: zazzled
components.responsibility: The daemon that builds, tests and calls zazz scripts.

components.name: zazz-worker
components.responsibility: The WASM host that runs a script's module, one fresh instance per call.

components.name: zazz scripts
components.responsibility: Script authors' Rust sources, written with std and the zazz SDK and shipped inside a .zazz; not part of this repository.

relationships.description: Embeds every source file (src/zazz/sdk.rs FILES, include_str!) and compiles them per toolchain and target, the SDK's hash being part of each build key; links the crate for proto, fdpass, cliargs, render, http::host_matches and Json.
Path dependency: proto and fdpass for the control socket, http for the guest's requests and the allowlist, Json and Error.
Register Handlers and call zazz::serve; tests use zazz::test.
